scorecard.note: excess return vs SPY from the close of the day first flagged; n under 25 is noise

backtest._note: Horizons are 60 and 120 sessions because the book holds for weeks to quarters. Excess return vs SPY after every past signal, all stocks pooled, signals at least 20 sessions apart per stock, results trimmed at the baseline's 1st/99th percentile. edge = signal mean minus ordinary-day mean. t_clustered treats each calendar month as one observation. WORKS = clustered t of 2 or more and positive in both halves. by_condition splits each archetype by whether SPY was above its 200-day and whether the stock's sector was beating SPY on the signal day: a condition is a candidate filter only if its edge and t are clearly better than the other side. Still uncorrected: survivorship (today's index members only, which flatters anything that buys a fallen stock), no stops, no costs.
